description: This file defines the 'DataList' class, an Android activity that displays a list of data queried from a content provider, allows interaction with list items to view details, and supports requerying the data.

classes.name: DataList
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that loads data via a content resolver query, displays it in a list, and handles item clicks to show detailed views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, performs data query, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases the cursor resource whenever the activity is stopped.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Requeries the data when the activity resumes and updates the title.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with a 'Requery' action.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to gather data, build a URI, and start a details activity.
